root_cause.text: In DecodeQ931(), the 16-bit length field is decremented by 1 to skip the protocol discriminator byte without a check for zero, causing an integer underflow that passes a huge length value to DecodeH323_UserInformation, leading to an out-of-bounds read.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message state: "reads a 16-bit length from the packet, then decrements it by 1 to skip the protocol discriminator byte before passing it to DecodeH323_UserInformation(). If the encoded length is 0, the decrement wraps to -1, which is then passed as a large value to the decoder, leading to an out-of-bounds read." The patch adds `if (len <= 0) break;` after the decrement.
